text: Before fixing anything, profile both extracts and see the actual problem directly, the same discipline the Beginner project used before touching any data.

The customer extract was exported, then re-exported a second time without clearing the first file. Every CustomerID and SalesOrderID pair from that first run now appears twice, so summing LineTotal straight out of this file would silently double count every sale from that batch.

The territory extract went through a spreadsheet review pass that introduced extra whitespace and inconsistent capitalization on TerritoryName for a handful of rows. Harmless to a human, but exactly the kind of thing that silently breaks a join or a group by.

Power Query could clean either problem, but this project uses Python deliberately: the fixes are short, reviewable code, and the same cleaned DataFrame gets reused for the join in Lesson 6, keeping the whole reconciliation in one place.
Next lesson writes the real pandas cleaning code: dropna, fillna, and drop duplicates, applied to both extracts.
